اخترطتا (form VIII)
# اِخْتَرَطَتَا (iḵtaraṭatā) /ix.ta.ra.tˤa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِخْتَرَطَ (iḵtaraṭa)
# اُخْتُرِطَتَا (uḵturiṭatā) /ux.tu.ri.tˤa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِخْتَرَطَ (iḵtaraṭa)
